about: Pose prompts for Corin, the player's axe leader. {pose} in the base is replaced by a pose's text. Every pose takes his standing image (art/source/corin-stand.jpg) as its one reference. A great axe attacks with an overhead chop: ready, wind-up (the axe raised behind his head), slash (the chop), follow-through, recover.
base: The exact same character as the reference: same face, wild auburn hair tied back, amber-gold and dark brown leather armour with iron plates, a brown fur mantle over his shoulders, blue armbands, a large double-bitted great axe, same colours, same art style, same size in frame. Three-quarter side view facing right. Pose: {pose}. He holds exactly one axe: no second axe, no afterimage, no ghost or blurred copies. A single sharp still frame: no motion blur, no speed lines, no smear, no sparks or effects. Whole figure in frame with margin around it, axe included, even studio lighting, no cast shadow. Plain flat pure green background (#00FF00), no green on the character, no text, no ground.

ready.pose: sinking into a low wide crouch, knees bent, the great axe held low across his body in both hands, gathering strength, a fierce grin

wind-up.pose: the axe raised high behind his head in both hands for an overhead chop, the blade pointing back over his shoulder, his back arched, weight on his back foot

slash.pose: mid-chop: stepping forward, the great axe swung down in front of him at waist height in both hands, arms fully extended, front knee bent, the blade forward

follow-through.pose: the chop finished: bent forward over his front knee, the axe head low near the ground in front of his front foot, both hands on the haft, fur mantle swinging forward

recover.pose: heaving the axe back up out of the chop: straightening up, weight shifting back, the axe rising in front of his chest in both hands

run.pose: running to the right mid-stride, one foot off the ground, the great axe held across his body in both hands, fur mantle flying behind

run-2.pose: running to the right in the passing position: one leg swinging past the other, both feet close to the ground, the great axe held across his body in both hands, fur mantle flying behind

hurt.pose: recoiling backward from a hit, head turned away, teeth gritted in pain, one arm raised, the axe lowered in the other hand, staggering

fallen.pose: fallen to one knee, slumped forward with his head down, defeated, the great axe lying on the ground beside him

victory.pose: standing tall in triumph, the great axe raised high above his head in both hands, roaring with a wide grin, fur mantle flowing; drawn smaller in the frame so that everything fits, from the top of the raised axe down to his boots, with empty space below his feet
